visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Both Calls Use n - 1
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The sequence should start 0 1 1 2 3 5 8, but the program prints 0 1 2 4 8 16 32.

solution.explanation: Each Fibonacci number is the sum of the previous two, so the second call must go back two steps. Adding fib(n - 1) to itself doubles the value every time, which gives powers of two.
